prose.text: The chunk's own probes come first, then the standard gate set in test-plan §3 order: `capability-drift` before the default-features workspace nextest, the `--features mcp-server` bindings regen as the last cargo-adjacent step, and the base-identity bindings close, since the chunk adds no procedure. The operator pass follows.

Absences, each with its reason: - No boot-smoke entry: neither file is on the boot-smoke trigger list (test-plan §3 Per-chunk gate discipline), and   the chunk boots no app. The boot smoke that matters here is the CI job, read in the operator pass. - No webview gate and no headful self-verify: no `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched. - No local pre-push gate: `cargo xtask pre-push:linux` cannot run on this host (test-plan amendment   `2026-10-02-incident-events-readable-through-mcp`); CI is the gate each push meets. - No liveness probe and no live leg: the chunk drives no external process (research.md, the harness slot). - No targeted nextest entry: steps 2 and 4 run the one binary as the red-before-green pair; the workspace nextest   entry runs the same tests on every re-run. - Step 7's mutations edit the workflow and revert, so they are one-shots at implement; the three tests in the   workspace nextest entry guard the properties on re-run. - No local run of `main`'s tests on the second branch's tree: it would be a cold build of a second checkout. Its   gate is its own pull-request run, which runs `main`'s whole workflow on three systems; the local entries prove   only that the patch applies to `main` and equals what the build tree holds.

The control entry and the three patch entries read files steps 5 and 8 write: on the untouched tree those files are absent and the entries read red. `cargo audit` reads the advisory database over the network. If an advisory is published between two readings, a red there is the gate working, not this chunk's defect: it is recorded, not re-run, and dispositioned at the wrap.

**The operator pass, in this order.** 1. The hygiene entry, then the pre-CI commit, then the build-branch push. 2. The second branch: one entry confirms `main` has not moved, cuts `hotfix/p-120-audit-step` from it in a scratch    worktree, applies the patch, commits with the prepared message and removes the worktree. Two reads follow before    anything else leaves the host: the branch differs from `main` in the two files only, and the build branch    still merges cleanly into it. Then the branch is pushed and its pull request into `main` is opened, ready for    review, not a draft. 3. The build branch's pull-request run is read, whole; then the second branch's pull-request run, whole. Each is    followed by its audit step's conclusion and its report-only jobs listing, by run id, as `<id>`. 4. **The founder-attended stop.** When the second branch's run is green the pass stops and says so, with the pull    request's number. The operator brings it to the founder. Nothing is merged and nothing is pushed to `main` by    the pass. If that run is red in a job the repair does not touch, the reading is recorded as it stands and    brought to the operator the same way; it is not re-run. 5. After his merge, on the operator's word: `main` is fetched and read to hold the repair; the push run on its new    tip is read, scoped to the `supply-chain` check. This is the witness. Then that run by its id, as `<id>`: the    audit step's conclusion, the job log holding cargo audit's scan line, the job log holding no check-run denial,    the runner image lines (report-only, for the evidence), and the jobs listing (report-only). 6. The meeting of the branches on the real commits: the build branch merges cleanly into the new `main`; pull    request #40's own mergeable word is recorded.

No run is re-run to obtain a green. The witness read is scoped to the `supply-chain` check so that it does not hang on a job the repair does not touch; the jobs listing beside it says whether every job of that push run is `success`, and the report states that word for `main` as a whole. `boot smoke (ubuntu-22.04)` and the `a11y` rows are read from all three listings and recorded as read; a red boot smoke on equal source is the folded watch's recurrence and goes to the wrap.
